reason: The text fragment depicts the theophany at the burning bush where God commissions Moses to lead the Israelites out of Egypt. The passage shows God responding with compassion to the Hebrews' suffering and affliction in Egypt (God hears their cry and sees their oppression). There is no depiction of Hebrew ingratitude toward their leaders or toward Yahweh. The text focuses on God's initiative in salvation and Moses' appointment as a leader, not on any ungrateful behavior by the Hebrew people.
